{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", sales.shape)
print("\nColumns:", sales.columns.tolist())
print("\nUnique customer_segment values:", sales['customer_segment'].unique().tolist())
print("\nUnique channel values:", sales['channel'].unique().tolist())
print("\nValue counts for converted:", sales['converted'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check for sentinel values
print("\nCount of customer_age == -1:", (sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print("\nNumber of refunded orders:", len(refunded))"}
